changes.title: Workbench created from the developer's 12 Sep ZIPs (backend, admin, frontend)
changes.notes: Three git repos initialised on branch dev from the uploaded archives (byte-identical to the archives the local tool held). No code changed yet.

changes.title: Sandbox blocked: network access = None
changes.notes: registry.npmjs.org, binaries.prisma.sh and Docker Hub return 403 host_not_allowed, so dependencies cannot be installed. Postgres 16 and Redis 7 are running locally. Waiting for the cloud environment's Network access to be set to Trusted.

changes.title: Ported: risk-terminal tick uses shared Redis; portable risk-terminal regression (8 checks)
changes.notes: Fixes buffered human stakes being counted as NPC volume on the Risk Terminal (human BUY 100 read as 0).

changes.title: Ported: NPC worker honours the saved OFF flag on boot; startup regression
changes.tests: validated 2/8 → 8/8 by the local tool · re-run pending
changes.notes: Behaviour change: a persisted STOP now survives worker restarts instead of being forced back ON.

changes.title: Ported: Risk Terminal drops stale socket ticks; NPC status shows runningOnLeader; admin npc-risk regression (16 checks)
changes.tests: validated 16/16 + Vite build by the local tool · re-run pending
changes.notes: 'SIMULATOR ACTIVE' no longer shown when the worker is not actually running; stale ticks expire after 5 s or on disconnect.

changes.title: Ported: eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.0.1 → 7.1.1 (clean npm ci)
changes.tests: strict install + build passed in the local tool · re-run pending
changes.notes: Removes the ERESOLVE peer conflict with ESLint 10 so CI no longer needs --legacy-peer-deps.

changes.title: Admin login/admin redirect loop for non-admin or incomplete sessions
changes.tests: validated 4/12 → 12/12 by the local tool (never applied there) · re-run pending
changes.notes: Guard reads user/token from the auth store; non-admin and half-restored sessions land on /unauthorized, which signs out before returning to login.

changes.title: CI: stop printing production API/socket URLs; npm ci; admin sw.js/manifest no-cache on CDN
changes.notes: Removed both 'Temporary Debug' steps that cat .env.production and grep the secret in dist. Admin PWA updates were delayed by CDN-cached sw.js.

changes.title: API honours CORS_ORIGIN / WS_CORS_ORIGIN allowlists; Swagger UI off in production unless SWAGGER_ENABLED=true
changes.tests: new jest spec (5 cases) · run pending
changes.notes: Backward compatible: with the variables empty the API still reflects any origin, but warns at boot in production. Set CORS_ORIGIN=https://ticktrade.app,https://dev.ticktrade.app,… on the servers.

changes.title: Chat: send clears input and dismisses keyboard; sender name above message (TikTok layout)
changes.notes: Contracted item S1. The input previously re-focused itself after send.

changes.title: Trade confirmation sheet honours the existing Settings toggle
changes.notes: Contracted item S3. User.tradeConfirmation was stored but never read; real-money BUY/SELL now confirm first, Free Tap unaffected.

changes.title: End-of-battle result pop-up off by default (build-time switch)
changes.notes: Contracted item S2 ('disable the end-of-battle message entirely'); VITE_BATTLE_RESULT_MODAL=true restores it.

changes.title: Stale email tests aligned with the documented rendering/naming contract
changes.tests: shared suite 187 → 184 pass / 3 fail (offline via tsx); API jest pending install
changes.notes: camelCase event segments allowed (password.temporarySet is a stored mapping key); HTML is master-wrapped and unresolved {{tags}} are stripped by design.

changes.title: Offline test mode: shared + engine suites now run here without dependencies
changes.tests: engine 74 ran: 62 pass / 12 fail (10 pricing + 2 suites needing decimal.js) · shared 187: 184/3
changes.notes: Reproduces the local tool's Docker results exactly, so pricing/hedge fixes can be iterated before the registry is unblocked.

changes.title: Cloud session bootstrapped from GitHub: registries reachable, three repos cloned (dev @ 12 Sep), all 12 recorded patches re-applied
changes.notes: registry.npmjs.org, binaries.prisma.sh and GitHub all reachable (network policy no longer blocks). Heads on dev are the developer's 12 Sep commits (backend 06:29, frontend 06:30, admin 06:31 UTC), i.e. the same baseline as the uploaded ZIPs. Two backend patches (npc-worker OFF flag, CORS allowlist) touch CRLF files and only apply with git am --keep-cr; bootstrap.sh now passes it.

changes.title: Workbench tooling fixes found while bringing the stack up on Linux
changes.notes: (1) backend/.npmrc sets symlink=false (a Windows workaround); on Linux pnpm 10.28/10.33 then fails in the @prisma/engines postinstall (cannot find @prisma/debug) — wb install passes --config.symlink=true without editing the repo. (2) seed:content-templates imports @ticktrade/shared, so wb db:seed builds the shared package first. (3) tsx/playwright are resolved from `npm root -g` instead of a hard-coded home. (4) probe/smoke launch the pre-installed Chromium (/opt/pw-browsers) and stub Google Fonts, which the sandbox browser cannot reach.

changes.title: Full stack running with dependencies: 7/7 services up, battle engine + NPC simulator live, zero errors in service logs
changes.tests: API 54/54 · engine 74/87 · shared 184/187 · admin npc-risk 16/16 · admin auth-routing 12/12
changes.notes: Prisma client generated, 84 migrations applied, admin + demo trader + 20 NPC fixtures seeded; api/engine/engine-worker/settlement-worker/npc-worker/frontend/admin started; battle 1 opened at 15:40:52 with two-sided NPC pots. The 16 failures are exactly the documented owner decisions: 10 pricing (D1: tests 1,7,8,9,10,18,27,28,31,38), 3 NPC protection (D3: 49 empty-side win / 50 dilution / 52 phase-2 boundary), 3 last-moment hedge (D2). The four ported fixes' regression suites (risk-terminal 8, npc-startup-off, cors 5, admin 16+12) all pass. Vite builds of frontend and admin succeed with the five/three patches applied; both repos' eslint is broken at baseline (frontend: eslint.config.js flat-config plugin format; admin: 146 pre-existing errors) — untouched.

changes.title: Browser smoke test (tools/browser-smoke.cjs): logged-in trading + admin flows, 14/14 checks
changes.notes: Verified in the real app: demo login; BUY opens the trade-confirmation sheet when the Settings toggle is on and Cancel places no stake (c0011); chat send clears the input and drops focus, sender name renders above the message (c0010); admin login reaches /admin with no redirect loop, a USER-role login lands on the 403 page and 'Sign in with another account' clears the session (c0007); Risk Management Terminal and NPC Simulator tabs render. Finding: admin/src/Pages/AdminDashboard/NpcSimulator.css @imports Google Fonts; when fonts.googleapis.com is unreachable (ad-blocker, firewall, offline) the whole /admin lazy chunk fails to preload its CSS and the dashboard shows 'React Application Error'. The smoke tool stubs the font host; the product fix (move the font <link> to index.html or self-host) is proposed, not applied.
